IconLib 46.4 by Peter Keunecke (freeware), the icon.library replacement.
Package: IconLib_46.4 (IconLib.guide and IconLib.html are its documentation; the licence is the
"Important Restrictions" section of IconLib.html).

icon.library.os30  Bonus/Libraries/256ColorPalette/icon.library_68020, $VER icon.library 46.4.595 (68020).
                   Installed on AmigaOS 3.0 and 3.1 (an unrestricted build).
icon.library.os32  Libs/icon.library, $VER icon.library 51.4.602 (TC020). Installed on AmigaOS 3.2 only.
                   The TrueColor (v51) builds may not be shipped in packages sold for more than 10 EUR
                   or in commercial bundles; Amarchy is free.

Install copies the one for the system to LIBS:icon.library when the "PeterK icon library" option is
ticked, after keeping the old library as LIBS:icon.library.amarchy-backup (only when no backup exists).
Uninstall puts the backup back.
